school_name: University of North Carolina School of the Arts
title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten distinct, no-admission ways to spend time outdoors, browse, or join a free campus activity in Winston-Salem.

cards.title: Walk Reynolda Gardens
cards.subtitle: 100 Reynolda Village, Winston-Salem
cards.notes: Meet at the gardens entrance, take a slow loop through the grounds, and use the benches or paths for an unhurried catch-up.
cards.short_summary: Free garden grounds with daily sunrise-to-sunset access.
cards.evidence_claim: Reynolda states that admission to Reynolda Gardens is always free and no ticket is needed.
cards.access_notes: Open daily sunrise to sunset; the historic house museum has separate ticketed admission.

cards.title: Stroll the Formal Gardens
cards.subtitle: Within Reynolda Gardens
cards.notes: Use the formal garden paths for a short, phone-free walk; stay on marked paths and leave plantings undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: A named garden area within Reynolda’s free grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: Reynolda describes its grounds and Formal Gardens, and confirms that admission to Reynolda Gardens is always free.
cards.access_notes: Reynolda Gardens is open daily sunrise to sunset; museum admission is separate.

cards.title: Take the Woodland Trail
cards.subtitle: Within Reynolda Gardens
cards.notes: Start from the garden grounds and follow the Woodland Trail at a conversational pace; bring water and check conditions after rain.
cards.short_summary: A wooded walking route through free Reynolda grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: Reynolda identifies the Woodland Trail and confirms that admission to Reynolda Gardens is always free.
cards.access_notes: Gardens are open daily sunrise to sunset; follow posted grounds policies.

cards.title: Pause at the Wildflower Garden
cards.subtitle: Within Reynolda Gardens
cards.notes: Use the Wildflower Garden as a meet-up point, then look for seasonal changes from the paths without picking flowers or entering beds.
cards.short_summary: A named garden area beside Reynolda’s woodland route.
cards.evidence_claim: Reynolda identifies the Wildflower Garden and confirms that admission to Reynolda Gardens is always free.
cards.access_notes: Gardens are open daily sunrise to sunset; pets are not permitted in the Formal Gardens.

cards.title: Browse the Garden Welcome Center
cards.subtitle: Reynolda Gardens, 100 Reynolda Village
cards.notes: Pair a garden walk with a stop at the Conservatory & Welcome Center; check the posted schedule before planning an indoor meet-up.
cards.short_summary: An indoor stop associated with Reynolda’s free garden visit.
cards.evidence_claim: Reynolda lists the Conservatory & Welcome Center at Reynolda Gardens and says garden admission is always free.
cards.access_notes: Conservatory & Welcome Center hours are Tue–Sat 9:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. and Sun 1:30–4:30 p.m.

cards.title: Explore Historic Bethabara Park
cards.subtitle: 2147 Bethabara Road, Winston-Salem
cards.notes: Walk the preserved grounds with friends and read the site markers; choose the self-guided outdoor visit rather than a paid guided tour.
cards.short_summary: Historic park grounds, trails, and wetlands open free year-round.
cards.evidence_claim: The City says Historic Bethabara Park grounds are open free of charge year-round from dawn to dusk.
cards.access_notes: Grounds are free from dawn to dusk; guided tours have separate admission.

cards.title: Walk the Mill Creek Loop
cards.subtitle: Historic Bethabara Park
cards.notes: Follow this named loop for a low-key walk and wildlife viewing; wear appropriate shoes and keep to the trail.
cards.short_summary: A named trail within Bethabara’s free historic park grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: The City identifies Mill Creek Loop at Historic Bethabara and says the park’s trails are open free of charge.
cards.access_notes: The free park grounds are open year-round from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Visit Bethabara’s Historic Gardens
cards.subtitle: Historic Bethabara Park
cards.notes: Make the gardens a calm conversation stop, then continue through the grounds; respect planted areas and posted preservation guidance.
cards.short_summary: Named gardens within the free Historic Bethabara grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: The City says Historic Bethabara Park’s grounds and gardens are open free of charge all day, all year.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor park, grounds, gardens, and trails are free; visitor-center hours vary seasonally.

cards.title: Browse Central Library
cards.subtitle: 660 W. Fifth Street, Winston-Salem
cards.notes: Choose a floor to browse together, use free library resources, or check the calendar for a public program before heading downtown.
cards.short_summary: Downtown public library with free access to resources, services, and programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Forsyth County Central Library states that it provides free access to a wide variety of resources, services, and programs.
cards.source_title: Forsyth County Central Library: Contacts for Entrepreneurs
cards.access_notes: Library system hours are Mon–Thu 9 a.m.–8 p.m., Fri 9 a.m.–6 p.m., and Sat 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; confirm holiday closures.

cards.title: Go to a Free UNCSA Campus Event
cards.subtitle: University of North Carolina School of the Arts campus
cards.notes: Check UNCSA’s event listings and attend an event marked free; confirm audience eligibility and ticket details before inviting friends.
cards.short_summary: UNCSA documents that many campus events are free.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCSA states that there are many free events on campus, alongside separately ticketed performances.
cards.access_notes: Availability, audience eligibility, and any reservation requirements vary by event; verify the individual event listing.
